_note: Hand rules for edda-site/pipeline/make_entities.py detect (task 16a). tags: overrides of the tag list per entity (first = main; vocabulary in entities.json `tags`). extra: entities that seed.json does not have — targets of the ambiguity rules, and the ones the curator asked for by message (they may carry forms, heiti, image candidates); wikidata to be filled by the curator. resolve.entities: per seed entity, a scope (row id, Snorri chapter like s-c62, part letter p/g/s/h, poem prefix like hh2, or *) -> an entity id (relabel), ok (certain), check (uncertain) or, for forms, skip (not a name here); the most specific scope wins; a value {prose: ..., verse: ...} distinguishes prose and verse blocks. resolve.forms: the same per surface form (for a form that several entities share). resolve.near: a byname in the same Old Norse row decides (entity -> {word: entity}). lists: name-list sections (chapter or row scopes) whose mentions are not narrative and never carry a first-appearance card. spellings: translator spellings per entity and language that the spelling-blind comparison misses. groups: the groups (Æsir, giants, dwarfs ...): entity -> {lang: word forms}, matched whole-word in any case; in Icelandic and English only where the row's Old Norse has the group.
